name: Hayakawa Naomi
source:
Known as the "Madonna of the School," Naomi is beloved by all the other girls in the school. When Rie spies her playing with Midori in the chapel, her attentions turn to the new arrival at the school. She carries a deep secret inside her.

[from [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/P020]J-List[/url]]
